key_insight: ParetoChat uses LLM agents to translate natural-language preferences into optimization parameters and help users explore trade-offs among conflicting objectives.
engineering_relevance: It offers an interaction layer that lets stakeholders steer multi-objective optimization without directly specifying numerical weights, priorities, or reference points.
method: Separate agents handle input, decision-making expertise, solution presentation, and feedback.
Translate user preferences into structured scalarization parameters and invoke an optimization system.
Present candidate solutions and refine the search through iterative feedback.
evidence_signal: Simulations with an LLM-based decision maker benchmarked ParetoChat against DESDEO reference-point and NIMBUS methods on binary knapsack and set-partitioning problems; historical courier-order assignments illustrated practical use.
watch_item: Evaluation with a simulated LLM decision maker leaves real-user preference fidelity and interaction reliability to be validated.
paper_title: ParetoChat: An LLM-Based Interface for Interactive Multi-Objective Optimization
